name: Slodds Baby Name Generator
author: Slodds

sections.description:
Shortcode: [slodds_baby_names] — paste it into any page or post to display the generator.

Slodds Baby Name Generator adds a clean, interactive name generator to your WordPress site, powered by the data team behind Babyna.me. Perfect for parenting blogs, pregnancy resource sites, and family-focused content.

Features

  • 200 curated baby names (100 boy + 100 girl) with real meanings and origins
  • Boy, girl, or all gender filter
  • Choose how many names to generate (1, 3, 5, or 10)
  • Light and dark theme support
  • Mobile responsive design
  • No external API calls — works entirely offline
  • No tracking, no cookies, no data collection
  • Lightweight — single JS and CSS file, no dependencies

Usage

Add the shortcode to any page or post:

[slodds_baby_names]

Shortcode Options

  • count — Number of names to show by default (1, 3, 5, or 10). Default: 5
  • gender — Default gender filter: all, boy, or girl. Default: all
  • theme — Color theme: light or dark. Default: light

Examples

[slodds_baby_names count="3" gender="girl"]
[slodds_baby_names count="10" theme="dark"]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the slodds-baby-name-generator folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Add [slodds_baby_names] to any page or post
  4. Optionally configure settings under Settings > Slodds Baby Names
sections.faq:
Does this plugin make external requests?

No. All name data is included in the plugin. No external API calls, no tracking, no cookies.

Can I customize the names?

The current version includes 200 curated names. Future versions may include the ability to add custom names.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes. The shortcode works with Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, and any other page builder that supports shortcodes.

Is there a credit link?

An optional credit link to Babyna.me can be enabled in Settings > Slodds Baby Names. It is off by default.

Is this plugin affiliated with WordPress, WooCommerce, or any other brand?

No. “Slodds” is the developer identity of Kyle Sloderbeck, the maintainer of Babyna.me (https://babyna.me). This plugin is not affiliated with WordPress, Automattic, WooCommerce, or any other entity.
